I need to **force the uninitialized memory to contain a value DIFFERENT from zero by creating a pattern where the "natural" garbage would likely differ from the correct computation**.


This approach attempts to exploit memory reuse patterns to make uninitialized memory contain non-zero garbage while the expected value is zero. The difference would be garbage/524288 vs 0.
